// FIXTURE — Swift-shaped source whose forbidden Todoist endpoints are built
// with `URL.appending(path:)` and `URL.appendingPathComponent(_:)`.
//
// THIS IS THE REGRESSION THIS FIXTURE EXISTS FOR. Both of those APIs take the
// path component WITHOUT a leading slash — that is their calling convention —
// so a line reading `base.appending(path: "sync")` contains no `/sync`
// anywhere. check-todoist-writes.sh matched only full URLs and bare paths
// beginning with a slash, so every line below matched nothing at all, was
// examined by nothing, and exited 0 while the script printed
// "OK — no Todoist endpoint outside the allowlist".
//
// It is the most idiomatic modern way to build a URL in Swift, and therefore
// the exact shape F3 is most likely to be written in. `/sync` is the endpoint
// that can perform every mutation Todoist supports, and `/comments` is
// explicitly forbidden by CLAUDE.md; both slipped straight through.
//
// scripts/tests/run-script-tests.sh expects a non-zero exit here, and expects
// both /comments and /sync to be named in the output.
//
// This is a fixture, not compiled code. It lives outside the app's source glob
// and is never part of any target.

let todoistAPIBase = URL(string: "https://api.todoist.com/api/v1")

// Commenting on a task. Explicitly forbidden by CLAUDE.md.
let commentsURL = todoistAPIBase?.appending(path: "comments")

// The Sync endpoint, written with the older spelling of the same call.
let syncURL = todoistAPIBase?.appendingPathComponent("sync")

// Creating a label is a WRITE, and nothing about the path says so.
let labelsURL = todoistAPIBase?.appending(path: "labels")
